This is a fictional press release written for offline testing. The organisations and figures are illustrative.

Otters were recorded at 412 of 520 survey sites in 2026, compared with 301 sites in the 2016 survey, according to the Sample Wildlife Service.

Signs of otters were found in all 12 river catchments surveyed, up from 9 catchments a decade ago.

The service linked the recovery to improved water quality and the removal of 27 weirs since 2018, but said the survey cannot prove cause and effect.

The next national survey is scheduled for 2031.
